intro.text: A food baked into large rolls called clemabread, common in Tashikk.
A Rosharan crop that takes hard work to grow, like tallew or lavis, and easily fails in floods. It is baked into large rolls called clemabread, common in Tashikk.

description.text: Clemabread is granular and crumbles easily, which makes it mushy to eat. Many rolls are filled with a spicy paste and may be served warm.

items.text: The Stump often served clemabread at Tashi's Light orphanage. Lift ranked it only a little above gruel.
